items.title: Stronger Q2 Results And Raised Outlook Could Be A Game Changer For Ulta Beauty (ULTA)

items.title: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Stock Could Be Overvalued On Raised 2026 Guidance
items.summary: Ulta Beauty stock has delivered a 43.8% gain over the past 5 years, yet current valuation checks flag the shares as screening on the expensive side rather than as a clear bargain. Recent news around growth plans and partnerships has kept Ulta Beauty in focus, but the broader signals raise questions about how much of that optimism is already reflected in the price.
